column1: # Directory-shrapnel ratchet.
# 2026-08-07: keys repointed after LLM -> Features/Eva and Onboarding ->
# Features/Onboarding. The recorded file counts and averages are carried over
# unchanged — regenerating instead would have reset the ratchet and permitted
# these directories to fragment further.
# 2026-08-08: LifeBoard/Features/Home/UI/ViewModels dropped, not raised. The
# nine loose Home view models from Presentation/ViewModels/ merged into it and
# pulled the average from 122.1 to 153.8 — above MIN_AVERAGE_LINES, so it is no
# longer a shrapnel candidate. Removing the row is stricter than raising it:
# the generic rule now fails the directory the moment it drops back below 150.
# 2026-08-14: LifeBoard/Features/Onboarding/Components dropped, not lowered.
# The nine-step flow's deletion took it from 26 files to 3, which is below the
# generic MIN_FILES threshold, so it is no longer a shrapnel candidate. Removing
# the row is stricter than keeping a lowered one: the generic rule now fails it
# again the moment it regrows past 8 files with a low average.
# Existing small-file concentrations. Do not add shards or reduce the average
# LOC until an intentional feature-boundary consolidation removes the entry.
